companies.name: Custom Ink
companies.publicFacts: Browser design and artist review accompany ordering; group forms collect participant sizes and payments.
companies.featureLesson: Reduce organizer effort while preserving a single accountable ordering workflow.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Use one shared design project, an organizer view, a size/variant matrix and an explicit campaign close. Create a reviewed batch request at close; keep participant payment states separate from the production order.
companies.boundary: TwelveSpec must still bind every proof to the exact variant and obtain its own production authorization. Group fund settlement remains reserved.
companies.unknown: Internal design engine, artwork algorithms, group settlement implementation and private APIs were not inspected.

companies.name: PCNA
companies.role: Promo supplier and sourcing workflow benchmark
companies.publicFacts: PCNA accepts authorized distributor applications and advertises decorated goods across apparel and hardgoods.
companies.featureLesson: Represent an external source as a supplier offer with decoration and fulfillment capabilities, rather than replacing the canonical product.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Store source product/part IDs, available methods, imprint areas, charge identifiers and fulfillment origins. Make account eligibility and service verification separate administrator steps.
companies.boundary: An expired marketing offer supplies no usable margin, order volume, current rush promise or entitlement.
companies.unknown: Main site fetch returned 403. Exact supported services, API profiles, negotiated costs and media rights require authorized documents.

companies.name: SanMar
companies.role: Blank apparel supplier and data integration benchmark
companies.publicFacts: Public integration choices include PromoStandards, flat files and direct services; brand and marketplace restrictions are published.
companies.featureLesson: Separate the blank garment, warehouse inventory and decorating operation; publication rights vary by channel.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Model style/color/size variants, warehouse-level inventory snapshots and blank-to-decorator job routing. Add channel restrictions to the publication gate and mapping provenance to every imported field.
companies.boundary: Website access, API access, brand image permission and marketplace authorization are distinct.
companies.unknown: Account cost tiers, freight, exact service versions, inventory reservation and decorator agreements remain unverified.

companies.name: Imprint.com
companies.publicFacts: Pricing depends on product, imprint colors, quantity and method; digital proofs are conditional rather than universal.
companies.featureLesson: A short guided configurator can expose complexity progressively and route exceptions to an assisted quote.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Ask method-dependent questions, update quantity-break comparisons and show the cost assumptions behind an estimate. Keep visual preview, proof review and production preflight as separate states.
companies.boundary: Selected-product shipping/setup offers cannot become global TwelveSpec pricing rules. Preserve the handoff’s stronger proof requirements.
companies.unknown: No public technical API contract was established in the sampled sources; internal pricing and artwork processing are unknown.

companies.name: 4imprint
companies.publicFacts: A representative supports ordering; proofs, post-approval production time and credit review are explicit parts of the published process.
companies.featureLesson: Pair customer self-service with an accountable rep and a clear queue for decisions.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Attach an account owner, task timeline, proof decision and promised date to each quote/order. Track artwork waiting time separately from supplier production and carrier transit.
companies.boundary: Vendor credit and cancellation policies do not override TwelveSpec prepaid/approved Net 15 policy.
companies.unknown: No private CRM, sourcing agreements, unit economics or API implementation was inspected.

companies.name: Printify
companies.role: POD catalog, routing and fulfillment benchmark
companies.publicFacts: The documented catalog distinguishes blueprint, provider and variant; routing can choose exact or similar alternatives within settings.
companies.featureLesson: A purchasable variant includes the fulfillment provider and print-area contract, with explicit substitution policy.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Build a provider-neutral adapter and routing proposal. Before a source change, compare exact item, print geometry, region, landed cost and promised date; require renewed authorization for material changes.
companies.boundary: Autonomous supplier spend remains Coming Soon. A similar product is never an invisible replacement for an approved item.
companies.unknown: Provider-specific quality, charges, geography, token scopes and observed fulfillment performance require account testing.

companies.name: OrderMyGear
companies.publicFacts: Company, pop-up, redemption and POD stores are advertised, with budgets and permissions; the operating dealer handles fulfillment and refunds.
companies.featureLesson: Store programs are policy-driven purchasing contexts with different close, funding and fulfillment behavior.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Create explicit program types, membership/eligibility, budgets, brand approvals and close dates. Carry store and allowance identity through cart, request, quote, order and cancellation.
companies.boundary: Points, fundraising allocations and real financial settlement must not be represented as interchangeable money.
companies.unknown: Plan entitlements, API schemas and customer-specific commercial rights remain unverified.

companies.name: PrintNow
companies.publicFacts: Enterprise documentation separates REST resources, webhooks and cXML/procurement integration; order operations include print-file retrieval and shipping updates.
companies.featureLesson: The editor, storefront, production files and order management need stable contracts rather than a visual-only connection.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Use revisioned templates, durable render jobs, private artifacts and a job-ticket handoff that names exact files and specifications. Keep provider APIs behind the same adapter boundary.
companies.boundary: Current Product API descriptions are narrower than marketing language about a full print catalog. Packaging CAD and validated 3D remain future.
companies.unknown: Internal rendering technology, template file format, license rights and tenant-specific endpoint access are unknown.

companies.name: VistaPrint
companies.role: Print self-service and account experience benchmark
companies.publicFacts: The design studio offers downloadable PDF proofs with product exclusions; account order history exposes order status and tracking.
companies.featureLesson: Give customers a portable review artifact and a clear path back to their saved work.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Add a version-bound proof download, accessible project history and an order timeline. A reorder starts a repriced draft with current availability and a visible comparison to the original.
companies.boundary: A screen or PDF preview is not evidence that a file passes method-specific prepress.
companies.unknown: No private template format, production engine, partner API or rendering internals were inspected.

companies.name: Printful
companies.role: POD order, asset and event integration benchmark
companies.publicFacts: API draft confirmation can trigger fulfillment charges; v2 is documented as Open Beta, and merchant and fulfillment billing are distinct.
companies.featureLesson: Separate an editable order draft from the financially consequential production submission.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Use exact provider variants and print files, a verified pre-submit gate, cost estimates, idempotency and shipment updates. Preserve supplier payable events separately from customer receipt/payout events.
companies.boundary: Pin the tested API version and capability. A successful catalog read does not verify production submission.
companies.unknown: Authorized account configuration, current region pricing, samples, branding options and actual API behavior remain untested.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.publicFacts: B2B documentation distinguishes company, location and contact; current plan differences include catalog assignments and advanced payment features.
companies.featureLesson: A buyer’s identity, company membership and location-specific commercial policy are different concerns.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Create company/location membership with roles, allowed catalogs, address books and approved terms. Keep TwelveSpec’s core commerce independent; an optional channel adapter maps external IDs later.
companies.boundary: This research does not authorize store migration or access to an existing Shopify store. Feature availability is plan-specific.
companies.unknown: App scopes, store entitlements, channel conflicts, subscription cost and merchant credentials remain outside this public research.

companies.name: BigCommerce
companies.role: B2B quote, portal and API permission benchmark
companies.publicFacts: B2B APIs expose company users, quotes and invoices; buyer-facing APIs and server management APIs use different contexts.
companies.featureLesson: Treat a buyer request, seller-issued quote and accepted agreement as distinct resources.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Use a customer quote portal with buyer-specific permissions and immutable seller revisions. Expose a narrow public projection while server-side staff commands retain cost and supplier data.
companies.boundary: Administrative tokens never belong in the customer browser; a buyer session cannot act as a company-wide administrator.
companies.unknown: B2B licensing, tenant roles, API scope and authenticated behavior were not tested.

companies.name: Oracle: NetSuite and Fusion ERP/SCM
companies.publicFacts: NetSuite documents approval limits and routing; Fusion exposes fulfillment tasks per line and publishes release-specific feature removals.
companies.featureLesson: Use explicit approvals, task history and change control. NetSuite and Fusion are separate product families.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Build requirement-level PO approval, per-line fulfillment tasks, holds, accountable owners and reconciliation queues. Connect accounting references without implementing a general ledger.
companies.boundary: Full GL, payroll, enterprise MRP and autonomous procurement stay Coming Soon; do not clone an ERP suite or removed Fusion planning behavior.
companies.unknown: No Oracle account, tenant configuration, integration license or internal ERP database was inspected.

companies.name: Smartpress
companies.role: Reseller print and proof-dependent scheduling benchmark
companies.publicFacts: The reseller program offers blind shipping and reorder workflows; turnaround starts after proof approval, with combined-job shipping dependencies.
companies.featureLesson: Print jobs need their own approval and completion dates inside a multi-job customer order.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Keep stock, finish, dimensions, proof revision, production clock, shipment grouping and blind-ship identity in the agreement. Calculate order readiness from required jobs, not the first completed item.
companies.boundary: A published reseller benefit is not an approved TwelveSpec trade account or a universal delivery guarantee.
companies.unknown: No public wire-level API contract was established; special quotes, account terms and current shipment constraints require confirmation.

companies.name: SinaLite
companies.role: Trade print catalog and order integration benchmark
companies.publicFacts: Official indexed pages describe catalog/pricing integration and a fuller option including orders, artwork, status and tracking.
companies.featureLesson: Catalog enablement and transactional fulfillment are separate integration milestones.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Add per-capability activation, source option mapping, order payload validation, private artwork transfer and acknowledgment reconciliation. Keep US/Canada currencies and catalogs distinct.
companies.boundary: Direct pages returned 403; indexed descriptions support discovery only, not schema or account verification.
companies.unknown: API protocol, sandbox, credentials, commercial eligibility, artwork rules and account-specific charges remain unverified.

companies.name: 4over
companies.role: Trade print options, file intake and production timing benchmark
companies.publicFacts: 4over advertises a trade API program; turnaround guidance distinguishes facility cutoff, production, proof and shipping dependencies.
companies.featureLesson: Print option combinations and facility calendars must survive the storefront-to-job transition.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Version exact stock/size/side/finish selections, keep front/back artwork roles distinct and schedule against the source facility calendar. Retain external order IDs for reconciliation.
companies.boundary: Old program marketing is insufficient to promise a currently supported endpoint, wholesale rate or delivery date.
companies.unknown: Authorized current API schemas, product rules, prices, facility capacity and file-transfer requirements remain unverified.

companies.name: GotPrint
companies.role: Broker portal and conditional API-access benchmark
companies.publicFacts: The broker program includes blind shipping and eligibility requirements; API terms describe qualified access, setup fees and limited data rights.
companies.featureLesson: Wholesale program eligibility and technical integration entitlement need separate records and expiry checks.
companies.twelveSpecDesign: Build an evidence checklist for approved reseller status, permitted media, supported operations and account-specific pricing. Enforce those gates before publishing or transmitting orders.
companies.boundary: Published API terms are not an executed agreement, current fee quote or valid access key.
companies.unknown: Current API onboarding, protocol, fee amount, qualification and product coverage require authorized confirmation.

features.title: Guided discovery and assisted handoff
features.customerFlow: Browse by product or purpose, filter available variants, save a shortlist and ask for help without retyping selections.
features.operatorFlow: Receive the same configuration, deadline and customer context in an assigned inquiry queue.
invariants: Search and counts use server pagination across the entire scoped catalog.
A failed query is an error state, not an empty catalog.
Anonymous discovery never reveals source costs or credentials.
proposedTests: Given more than 1,000 variants, a matching item beyond the first page is discoverable.
Submitting twice with the same request key creates one inquiry.
A customer response contains no supplier costs or credential fields.
features.dependencyRule: Foundation gates apply before dependent behavior; see ordered implementation waves in SOFTWARE_BLUEPRINT.md.
features.evidenceBoundary: Vendor behavior inspired this original design; proposed records, rules, commands, events and tests are not vendor internals or completed implementation.

features.title: Dependent options and apparel quantity matrix
features.customerFlow: Choose product, color, size quantities, method and location; incompatible selections explain what must change.
features.operatorFlow: Preview and publish a versioned family rule set with exact imprint zones and minimum/increment rules.
invariants: Size rows resolve to exact canonical variants; a family selection is not a purchasable SKU.
Quantity breaks use the configured grouping rule; mixed methods or artworks do not silently share a tier.
A product or template change invalidates prior configuration approval.
proposedTests: A disallowed method/location combination cannot enter the cart.
A size matrix with a missing price stays quote-only.
Changing the template leaves an issued order’s snapshot unchanged.
features.dependencyRule: Foundation gates apply before dependent behavior; see ordered implementation waves in SOFTWARE_BLUEPRINT.md.
features.evidenceBoundary: Vendor behavior inspired this original design; proposed records, rules, commands, events and tests are not vendor internals or completed implementation.

features.title: Canonical products, supplier offers and media rights
features.customerFlow: See one truthful product identity with its available variants and permitted images.
features.operatorFlow: Compare multiple source offers, resolve uncertain matches, approve publication and inspect field provenance.
invariants: Supplier part identifiers are scoped to connection and provider.
Ambiguous matches enter a review queue; title similarity alone never merges products.
Disabled, rolled-back, expired or unlicensed offers cannot supply a new commercial price.
proposedTests: Two providers with the same SKU string remain distinct source parts.
Rolling back an import makes its new offers ineligible for quoting.
An image with expired channel rights is absent from the customer projection.
features.dependencyRule: Foundation gates apply before dependent behavior; see ordered implementation waves in SOFTWARE_BLUEPRINT.md.

features.title: Component pricing with quantity precision
features.customerFlow: See a quantity comparison and clear quote-only reasons for incomplete costs.
features.operatorFlow: Compare landed costs and apply the versioned margin policy with an audited exception flow.
invariants: Preserve supplier unit precision until quantity extension; round commercial totals by policy.
Missing freight, setup, decoration or currency is unknown, not zero.
Target margin uses cost/(1-margin); a 40% markup is not a 40% margin.
Tax collected for remittance is excluded from margin revenue.
proposedTests: Unit cost 0.0250 times quantity 1,000 extends to 25.00.
An unknown freight cost blocks a firm checkout price.
A below-floor quote cannot be issued without a valid scoped override.
features.dependencyRule: Foundation gates apply before dependent behavior; see ordered implementation waves in SOFTWARE_BLUEPRINT.md.
features.evidenceBoundary: Vendor behavior inspired this original design; proposed records, rules, commands, events and tests are not vendor internals or completed implementation.

features.title: Shared 2D design project and private assets
features.customerFlow: Customize text and artwork on a product-specific 2D canvas, save a project and resume it on another device.
features.operatorFlow: Open the same project, adjust with permission and produce a new revision with an attributable history.
invariants: The project binds product, variant, method, location and template revision.
Each save creates an immutable revision; assets use private durable storage.
Changing a saved color or size rebinds the project and invalidates approvals that no longer apply.
proposedTests: Saving then changing the cap color creates a correctly bound project/revision.
A collaborator from another workspace cannot read a private asset.
An interrupted render can resume without losing the saved design.

features.title: Brand-controlled editable templates
features.customerFlow: Choose an approved company template and edit only permitted text, image and color fields.
features.operatorFlow: Lock logo placement, set fonts and color rules, preview changes, then publish a new template version.
invariants: A customer cannot unlock a protected field through a crafted API request.
Font and asset rights are checked before publication or export.
Template updates do not silently replace issued proofs or accepted specifications.
proposedTests: Changing a locked logo layer is rejected server-side.
An invalid text overflow is reported before save or proof generation.
A new template revision preserves existing accepted order artifacts.

features.title: Version-bound proof and method-specific prepress
features.customerFlow: Review the exact configured item, request a revision or approve a named proof version and download the artifact.
features.operatorFlow: Run method-specific checks and record qualified manual review for checks that cannot be automated.
invariants: Preview, customer proof approval and production preflight are independent gates.
A proof hash alone is insufficient: product, variant, design, method and location must also match.
No unconditional pass is allowed; unresolved review stays blocked.
Changes to the relevant content or specifications revoke affected approvals.
proposedTests: A proof from another product with the same artwork hash is rejected.
Editing artwork after approval blocks production release.
An authorized manual review records reviewer, checks, evidence and exact revision.

features.operatorFlow: Assign a rep, identify missing information, compare supplier alternatives and issue a clear revision.
invariants: Request submission creates no supplier spend or false paid order.
Request revisions preserve what changed and who answered.
A supplier estimate expires independently from a customer quote.
proposedTests: Missing destination is visible as a freight uncertainty.
Duplicate RFQ submission produces one durable request.
An expired supplier estimate forces repricing before a new firm quote.

A contact may belong to multiple companies without sharing their private orders.
Buyer administrator privileges never imply TwelveSpec staff or finance privileges.

features.title: Company-store budgets through checkout
features.customerFlow: Shop a permitted company catalog, see remaining allowance and submit any required manager approval.
features.operatorFlow: Reserve budget against an exact agreement, approve within limits, release on cancellation and reconcile actual usage.
invariants: Store, brand kit, budget and membership identity survive cart → RFQ → quote → order.
Reservation and acceptance are atomic; concurrent buyers cannot overspend.
Cancel/expiry releases a reservation exactly once; fulfillment converts commitment under the approved policy.
proposedTests: Two concurrent 60.00 orders against 100.00 cannot both reserve.
A forged brand kit or store context fails at quote acceptance.
A duplicate cancellation releases budget once.

features.title: Campaign close and group quantity collection
features.customerFlow: Enter eligible size/variant choices before a clearly displayed campaign close time.
features.operatorFlow: Review participation, resolve minimums and exceptions, close the campaign and create reviewed production batches.
invariants: Campaign close uses a stored timezone and server clock.
Minimum quantity failure creates a decision queue, never an unapproved purchase.
Fundraising allocation is a reference; complex fund settlement remains disabled.
proposedTests: A selection after the close boundary is rejected.
Repeating close does not create duplicate production batches.
A below-minimum campaign opens a hold rather than charging or purchasing.

features.title: Redemption and allowance identity
features.customerFlow: Redeem an eligible one-time allowance for approved items and see any policy-based balance.
features.operatorFlow: Issue scoped grants with expiry, revoke unused grants and review redemption attempts.
invariants: Store only a hash of a secret redemption code.
Redemption is atomically single-use or explicitly quantity-limited.
Points and allowances are distinct from cash, processor payment and fundraiser settlement.
proposedTests: Two simultaneous uses of a single-use code produce one reservation.
A code for another program cannot buy an unassigned item.
Expired grants fail without consuming allowance.

features.title: BYOB kits with assembly and multi-source cost
features.customerFlow: Build an eligible kit with required and optional components, packaging and a truthful complete estimate.
features.operatorFlow: Approve the bill of materials, source components, receive them, assemble and inspect the kit before dispatch.
invariants: Kit identity, quantities, packaging and labor survive commercial snapshots and job allocation.
A component substitution creates a new kit revision and relevant reapproval.
Dispatch waits for required components and assembly QC, not just the first source shipment.
proposedTests: A cart round-trip retains kit identity and assembly charges.
One missing component blocks a complete-kit shipment.
Component quantity changes trigger full kit repricing.

features.title: Immutable quote, acceptance and approved terms
features.customerFlow: Compare issued revisions, review seller and assumptions, then accept an unexpired agreement with approved payment terms.
features.operatorFlow: Issue a frozen revision, obtain margin/credit approvals and verify customer acceptance independently from payment.
invariants: An accepted quote is immutable; any commercial change requires a new revision.
Credit exposure aggregates relevant open obligations at acceptance.
Handoff policy: first two orders prepaid; later Net 15 requires a qualifying approval.
A browser return URL never establishes payment received.
proposedTests: Acceptance after expiry fails even with a stale browser tab.
Two concurrent orders cannot exceed the approved credit exposure.
Changing seller, totals or specifications invalidates prior approval hashes.

features.title: Saved carts, account history and safe reorder
features.customerFlow: Resume saved projects and carts, view order progress and start a reorder with a visible change summary.

Store and kit context are retained and revalidated.
Previous artwork approval can be reused only under an explicit exact-match policy.
proposedTests: A discontinued prior variant becomes a visible exception.
Current prices replace prior estimates only in the new draft.
